message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large, dark gray serif lettering across the upper section. A date below reads "21-27 SEPTEMBER 2015". The background consists of dense, swirling gray and white clouds or smoke filling the frame. Centered in the middle ground is the silhouette of a person running toward the right. This figure is partially transparent, blending into the surrounding clouds.

Large, bold white sans-serif text overlays the central figure, reading "BIROKRASI" above the word "ASAP". Below this, smaller black text states: "HUKUM TAK TEGAK, PEMERINTAH SALING TUDING. PERSOALAN BERULANG DARI TAHUN KE TAHUN."

A thick red vertical band runs along the far left edge, with a thinner red horizontal bar at the bottom. The top of the cover features smaller white text: "MENGAPA OMBUDSMAN MEMBEKAP KASUS NOVEL BASWEDAN" on the left and "GADUH RIZAL RAMLI DI PERTAMINA" on the right. In the bottom left corner, there is a price of "RP 39.500", a website, and a barcode with the numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00030".
